title: Desire, Etc. for the Suffering Interior

Dukkhachandādisutta Desire, Etc. for the Suffering Interior

“Yaṁ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṁ, tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo. “Mendicants, you should give up desire … greed … desire and greed for what is suffering. Kiñca, bhikkhave, dukkhaṁ? And what is suffering?

Cakkhu, bhikkhave, dukkhaṁ; tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo …pe… The eye, ear, nose, jivhā dukkhā …pe… tongue, body, mano dukkho; tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo. and mind are suffering …” Yaṁ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṁ tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti.
